ok.description: Always `true`; failure becomes an HTTP error.

mensagemId.description: Id of the `chat.message` event recorded for this message — the id that cancels it while it waits in the queue.

entrega.description: `lida`: the agent started a turn with it right away. `enfileirada`: the agent was mid-turn, so the message joined its queue and will be read, together with any others queued, in ONE turn when the current one ends (RN-673). The session log carries `chat.message_queued` / `chat.message_delivered` / `chat.message_cancelled`.

posicao.description: Position in the queue (1 = next). Present only when `entrega` is `enfileirada`.

400.description: Invalid body. The `ValidationPipe` runs with `whitelist` and `forbidNonWhitelisted`, so an unknown field also fails.

401.description: No token, expired token, or invalid signature.

404.description: Project, session, or handoff not found.

409.description: The agent is not active in this session; or it is waiting on an execution-plan decision; or its queue already holds 10 messages (`fila_de_mensagens_cheia`) — the message was recorded but NOT read by the agent (ADR 0163, RN-673).

422.description: The agent does not take chat messages (the Infra Lead works by proposal, and any slug without its own clause in the engine is refused by name) — the message was recorded but NO agent read it (RN-584).

429.description: Rate limit per user or per IP.
